title: Book your event
intro: Send the date, the place and what kind of event it is. I'll confirm availability within one working day and send a quote.

sessions.name: Conference coverage
sessions.duration: Half day, full day or multi-day
sessions.includes: Keynotes, panels, audience, networking and branding. Same-evening previews for social media.

sessions.name: Seminar or workshop
sessions.includes: Speakers, participants and group work, photographed silently and without flash.

sessions.name: Corporate event
sessions.includes: Launches, team events, office days and reportage for websites and annual reports.

sessions.name: Speaker & business portraits
sessions.includes: Portable on-site studio, retouched portraits within 24 hours.

sessions.name: Aftermovie & reels
sessions.includes: A 1–3 minute aftermovie plus vertical reels for social media.

successMessage: Thank you. I've received your request and will confirm availability within one working day.

successSteps.title: Within one working day
successSteps.text: I confirm availability and ask about your event programme.

successSteps.title: A clear proposal
successSteps.text: We agree coverage, deliverables and terms before booking.

successSteps.title: Your date is reserved
successSteps.text: After confirmation, we prepare a shot list together.
